title: History: projects ordered by their latest message, and each conversation shows its last message time
story: In the History tab, each project's directory groups (the checkout, each worktree, any other folder) used to always start with the checkout; now the group with the newest message comes first. Each conversation row used to show only '3h ago'; now it also shows the time of its last message, and the date when that was not today. The order of projects themselves and the Resume picker are unchanged.

checks.criterion: The group with the most recent message is first, whatever its kind.
checks.steps: Open a project that has at least one worktree. Start a conversation in the worktree and send 'hello test', with the checkout's newest conversation older than that. Open the History tab and expand the project.
checks.expected: The worktree's group is listed above the checkout's group; groups with no conversations come last.

checks.criterion: Each conversation shows its last message time.
checks.steps: Open the History tab and expand a project. Look at the line under a conversation's name, for one from today and one from an earlier day.
checks.expected: Today's reads like '3h ago · 14:32' (time in the user's locale); an earlier day adds the date, like '3d ago · Aug 8, 09:05'; a conversation older than 30 days shows its date and time once each. Hovering still shows the full date and time.
